summary.overview: The Project Initiation and Onboarding meeting between Andrew and Shams was focused on reconnecting and discussing a new project following Andrew's company acquisition of a LinkedIn lead generator software. The meeting began with an update on the busy period ahead due to new clients coming on board in March, establishing Shams' availability for up to 40 hours per week. Key topics included the project's goal of managing LinkedIn communications to set up calls with potential leads, demonstrated through the Deal Engines dashboard. The two discussed flexible working arrangements, with an initial plan to start with fewer hours, and decided against using Upwork for transactions. Shams was set up with a Capital A email address and provided a US phone number, while action items were delegated, including Shams' email profile setup and further communication with team members regarding project tools and work hours.
summary.short_summary: Andrew and Shams convened to discuss a new project centered on managing LinkedIn communications, following Andrew's acquisition of a lead generator software. The meeting highlighted upcoming busy periods due to new clients starting in March, with Shams confirming availability for up to 40 hours per week. They outlined the project goal of setting up calls with potential leads, demonstrated via the Deal Engines dashboard. Flexible working arrangements were discussed, agreeing to start with fewer hours and potentially increase them later. They also decided against using Upwork for transactions. Shams was set up with a Capital A email address, assigned a US phone number, and tasked with setting up an email profile and communicating with team members about project tools and work hours.
